title: mtu test script failing for chassis-packet
author: abdosi
body:
mtu test script failing for chassis-packet for 2 reason:

1. Router mac is per asic
2. Backend port/port-channel do not have peer interface with ip address

linkedPullRequests.title: [chassis-packet] fixed test_mtu.py
linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
What I did:

```

-  Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/5049

-     Also added 2 new API in common code:

    1. `get_router_mac` for SonicAsicHost as router-mac can be different for
    each ASIC. Modified some test cases to use this new API

    2. `is_backend_port` to filter Backend router port interfaces.
```
This PR depends on: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/5011
